convention: intensity = photons per 100 decays of the entry nuclide including the listed short-lived daughters (branching x equilibrium activity ratio). Natural-series members are separate entries; series_factor = activity relative to series head at secular equilibrium. kind g=gamma x=X-ray a=annihilation; src I=IAEA ENSDF (ndlab/LiveChart), S=SandiaDecay; optional 5th value = standard uncertainty of the intensity (photons per 100 decays, ENSDF, combined in quadrature over merged entries and scaled like the intensity; absent when not stated or for S lines)
